reviewPassage:
To: Product support and inventory
Subject: How to read the returned headset count

The trial page counts headsets, not reports. Two customers recently wrote separately about the same headset they share. The inventory team matched the serial numbers and combined the two reports into one record. Both descriptions remain in the notes.

A replacement may arrive while the original is still at the customer’s office. A case remains open whether the replacement is working or not. We close it only after the original is received and its serial number is matched to the case. Leave the case open if the carrier confirms delivery but inventory has not matched the number. Otherwise, the count would drop before we could confirm what came back.

When reviewing the page, please distinguish an open case from a headset that is still in transit to us. The carrier may already have delivered it even if inventory has not yet matched the serial number.
reviewPassageZh:
收件人：產品支援與庫存管理部門
主旨：如何解讀退回耳機的數量

試辦網頁統計的是耳機數，不是通報件數。最近兩位顧客分別來信，談的是他們共用的同一副耳機。庫存管理人員核對序號後，把兩則通報合併成一筆紀錄。兩則描述都保留在備註裡。

替換品可能已送到，但原耳機仍在顧客的辦公室。不論替換品是否正常運作，案件仍不結案。只有在收到原耳機，並確認它的序號和該案件相符後，才會結案。若承運人確認已送達，但庫存管理人員還沒核對序號，請不要結案。否則，在確認退回了什麼之前，統計數字就會下降。

查看頁面時，請區分尚未結案的案件，和仍在運送途中、尚未送到我們這裡的耳機。即使庫存管理人員還未完成序號比對，承運人也可能已經把耳機送達。
